# Monitor loop
inotifywait -m -e create -e moved_to --format '%f' "$WATCH_DIR" | while read FILENAME
do
 # Define logic for file types
 case "$FILENAME" in
 *.pdf)
 mv "$WATCH_DIR/$FILENAME" "$PDF_DIR/"
 ;;
 *ClientA*)
 mv "$WATCH_DIR/$FILENAME" "$CLIENT_DIR/ClientA/"
 ;;
 *)
 # Optional: No-op for unhandled files
 ;;
 esac
done
